input.command:
python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs 36: Chair 2
# left back leg bottom y=349 (col ~ 437)
# front legs bottom y=408 (col ~ 470)
# Center of chair 2 ground base: y ~ (349 + 408) / 2 = 378.5, col ~ 470
# Let's compute chair 2 position from obs 36:
# Pose 36: pos=(0.5, 3.3), heading=0.0
f, h, cy, cx = 256.0, 1.55, 255.5, 255.5
col = 470.0
y_ground = 378.5
d = f * h / (y_ground - cy)
dx = (col - cx) * d / f
chair2_x = 0.5 + dx
chair2_y = 3.3 + d
print(f'Chair 2 from obs 36: d={d:.3f}, dx={dx:.3f} -> x={chair2_x:.3f}, y={chair2_y:.3f}')

# Plant 1 in obs 36:
# Pose 36: pos=(0.5, 3.3), heading=0.0
# Pot in obs 36: col ~ 100..200
p_mask = (img := cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0036.png'))
pot_mask = (img[:,:,2] > 140) & (img[:,:,0] < 80) & (img[:,:,1] < 100)
pys, pxs = np.where(pot_mask)
print('Plant 1 in obs 36: xs:', pxs.min(), pxs.max(), 'center:', (pxs.min()+pxs.max())/2)
print('Plant 1 pot bottom y:', pys.max())
contact_y = pys.max()
center_x = (pxs.min() + pxs.max()) / 2
d_plant = f * h / (contact_y - cy)
dx_plant = (center_x - cx) * d_plant / f
plant_radius = ((pxs.max() - pxs.min()) / 2.0) * d_plant / f
plant1_x = 0.5 + dx_plant
plant1_y = 3.3 + d_plant + plant_radius
print(f'Plant 1 from obs 36: d={d_plant:.3f}, dx={dx_plant:.3f} -> x={plant1_x:.3f}, y={plant1_y:.3f}')
"
